control.name: CONTROL — remove the append-only shrink guard entirely (a whole-file PUT that reverts rows ships as success)

mutations.name: the --root join becomes a no-op (a repo-relative --evidence-file is read from the process cwd, not the --root checkout — #1709 defeated)
drop the absolute-path-with---root refusal (an absolute --evidence-file silently ignores --root instead of being refused)
disarm the shrink comparison (a commit with FEWER rows than the remote is no longer refused — unattributable row deletion ships)
scan the whole merged file instead of the bytes this landing adds (a brief already carrying a secret-shaped run can never receive an Evidence append again — #901/#966/#1161 re-opened)
addedLines stops subtracting the lines the branch already carries (every line of the commit is scanned as new — a Verify row's own quoted run re-refuses forever, #1161)
drop the origin from a scan refusal (the operator is back to isolating by hand which line tripped it — #1161 ask 3)
drop the pre-existing notice (a brief carrying a secret-shaped run lands silently; nothing tells the operator the scan saw it and where — #1161 ask 3)
